metadata.description: A method library of Agent Skills for AI-agent-driven work, organised by direction: coding (development-process discipline for coding agents — plan, build, gate), ai-os (the headless AI assisting system — job archetypes, wiki onboarding and maintenance), and productivity (individual AI-assisted work — writing, markdown and explainers a person can understand), plus reading-vocab, an upstream plugin pinned to a release (reading notes into Anki cards). Shared by interactive Claude Code / Cowork sessions and automated pipelines.

plugins.name: coding
plugins.description: Development-process skills for coding agents: agent-tiered-planning, design-direction-lock, implementation-discipline, iterative-acceptance, adversarial-review, silent-failure-design — plan, build, gate and verify a change across a mixed-capability agent pool.

plugins.name: ai-os
plugins.description: Framework + Agent Skills for a headless AI assisting system over real folders: pre-onboarding (the entry point for preparing a lived-in folder, with folder-curation and wiki-onboarding as its components), project-onboarding, wiki-maintenance, user-onboarding, file-preprocessing.

plugins.name: productivity
plugins.description: Skills for individual AI-assisted knowledge work: ai-writing-audit (check a draft for the signs of AI authorship and rewrite so it reads as human), portable-markdown (write .md a person will open in Typora or Obsidian, so the links land and no raw markup shows), controlled-writing (explain in ASD-STE100-style controlled language so output is fast to read and check), bespoke-explainers (choose and build a diagram, interactive page or narrated video explainer) and private-repo-access (read access to a private repository, such as an upstream plugin's, for a person with no GitHub account, through a deploy key).

plugins.name: reading-vocab
plugins.description: Hosted upstream in chenspc/reading-vocab (private; install needs access) and pinned here to a release. reading-vocab: turn the words a reader jots while reading, plus the book file, into dictionary-grounded Anki cards carrying the book's own sentences and a Chinese gloss per sense. compare-words: a second Anki deck of near-synonym groups. The skills drive the reading-vocab MCP server in the user's own clone of that repository.
